title: ScienceSep 4, 2026Formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem We are sharing the first complete computer-checked proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem. Claude worked largely autonomously over 11 days to write the proof in the Lean programming language.
content: ScienceSep 4, 2026Formalizing Fermat's Last Theorem We are sharing the first complete computer-checked proof of Fermat’s Last Theorem. Claude worked largely autonomously over 11 days to write the proof in the Lean programming language.
summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布 Claude 在 11 天内基本自主完成了费马大定理的首个计算机可验证形式化证明，使用 Lean 语言编写。这是 AI 自主长程编码与形式化推理能力的里程碑，展示了 Claude 在超长任务链、自我验证和复杂符号推理上的边界。对理解 AI 编程 agent 的自主性上限和形式化验证工作流有重要参考价值。
pin_reason: AI 自主完成世界级数学定理形式化证明的开创性里程碑，是衡量 Claude 长程自主编码能力的标志性案例，具备长期参考价值。

title: v2.1.278
content: What's changed Changed auto mode for Claude API and Enterprise users, and on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways, to default to the server-side classifier, which does not charge for classifier overhead ( CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 opts out on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and gateways); warns on billed fallback. See https://code.claude.com/docs/en/auto-mode-classifier-billing Added an Auto mode server row to /status showing whether this session's auto mode classifier runs on the server
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.278 将 Claude API、企业版以及 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 和网关用户的 auto 模式默认切换为服务端分类器，不再对分类器开销计费（可通过 CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0 退出），并在回退到计费模式时发出警告。同时 /status 新增「Auto mode server」一行，显示当前会话的分类器运行位置。
